events.name: Bighorn Sheep Guzzler Cleanup
events.place: Lake Mead NRA (location sent on registration)
events.description: Support the park's native bighorn sheep by trimming vegetation around guzzlers, which provide a valuable water source for the herds. Space is limited.

events.name: International Volunteer Day Cleanup
events.place: Lake Mead NRA (location sent on registration)
events.description: Celebrate International Volunteer Day by cleaning up trash from a popular area of the park. Registered volunteers receive the location and a free-entry password.

events.name: Christmas Bird Count at Lake Mead
events.place: Lake Mead NRA (location sent on registration)
events.note: Beginners welcome; hike or boat survey routes. Registration required.
events.description: Join NPS biologists for the nation's longest-running community-science bird project, surveying birds of Lake Mead and Lake Mohave. Choose a hike or a (longer) boat survey route.

events.name: Santa Train
events.place: Nevada State Railroad Museum, 601 Yucca St
events.description: Santa Train at Nevada State Railroad Museum, 601 Yucca St. Weekends Nov 28–Dec 20. $12.

events.name: Community Christmas Tree Lighting
events.description: Community Christmas Tree Lighting at Frank Crowe Park, Boulder City. Free.

events.name: Doodlebug Craft Bazaar
events.place: Boulder City Parks & Rec gymnasiums, 900 Arizona St
events.description: Doodlebug Craft Bazaar at Boulder City Parks & Rec gymnasiums, 900 Arizona St. Free.

events.name: Santa's Picture Party
events.description: Santa's Picture Party at Bicentennial Park Gazebo, Boulder City. Free.

events.name: Santa's Electric Night Parade
events.description: Santa's Electric Night Parade at Historic District, Boulder City. Free.

events.name: Twelfth Night Handbell Festival Concert
events.description: Twelfth Night Handbell Festival Concert at Boulder City Recreation Center. Public concert.

events.name: Best Dam Wine Walk
events.description: Boulder City Chamber of Commerce's monthly wine walk through 25+ shops in the historic downtown, with a themed dress-up each month.
know: 21+ only; bring a valid physical ID.
Includes a Tossware cup, wristband and map.
All sales final, rain or shine.

events.name: Classic Car Meetup at Chilly Jilly'z
events.place: Chilly Jilly'z Bakery & Cafe, 1680 Boulder City Pkwy
events.note: Weekly Friday-night patio car meetup; all makes welcome. Confirm with the cafe on holidays.
events.description: A weekly Friday-night classic car meetup on the patio at Chilly Jilly'z, open to all makes and models.

events.name: Last Friday Before Christmas
events.description: Downtown Boulder City's last Last Friday of 2026: 40-plus women-owned businesses and makers selling gifts, boutique fashion, handmade goods and holiday sweets under the lights.

events.name: Christmas Fest at Hope Church
events.place: Hope Church Boulder City, 850 Avenue B
events.description: A free family Christmas celebration with a live nativity, petting zoo, trunk-or-treat candy, carnival games, photo booths, cookies and hot cocoa.

events.name: Community Christmas Dinner
events.description: A free Christmas Day dinner for the whole community, sponsored by the Boulder City Historical & Arts Foundation and listed by the BC Recreation Department.
events.note: Free and open to everyone in the community.

events.name: Last Friday Female Entrepreneur Market
events.place: Downtown Boulder City, 501 Nevada Way (Arizona St & Nevada Way)
events.description: Boulder City's Last Friday market brings 20+ women-owned small businesses to the corner of Arizona Street and Nevada Way downtown, on Black Friday this month.

events.name: Cookies & Cocoa with the Council
events.note: Same day as Santa's Electric Night Parade.
events.description: Boulder City council members serve cookies and hot cocoa to residents at Frank Crowe Park on parade day.

events.name: Taste of Christmas at St. Andrew's
events.place: St. Andrew Catholic Church Community Center, 1399 San Felipe Dr
events.note: After the 9:30am Mass; open to the entire community.
events.description: A holiday food gathering in St. Andrew's community center that the parish opens to all of Boulder City.

events.name: Caroling Karaoke: A Night at the North Pole
events.note: First-year event; a community carol sing turned into a winter wonderland.
events.description: Christian Center turns its building into a little North Pole for an evening of Christmas karaoke carols, community and holiday fun, in place of driving around town to carol.

events.name: Mornings at the Gardens
events.place: Teddy Fenton Community Gardens, 300 Railroad Ave
events.note: Fall and winter garden advice from local gardeners.
events.description: Local gardeners at Boulder City's community gardens share tips for getting fall and winter gardens started and growing.

events.name: Reaper Madness Mountain Bike Races
events.note: Gravity mountain bike racing; free to watch. Rider entry fees apply.
events.description: Bootleg Canyon Gravity Racing's winter mountain bike race weekend on the Bootleg Canyon trails above Boulder City.

events.name: Annual Turkey Shoot
events.note: Drop in any time 6–8pm. Cash only; bring small bills.
events.description: Boulder City Parks and Recreation's family Thanksgiving target-shooting tradition at the ABC Park gym (not the fitness center); no turkeys are harmed.
know: The gym is at the back of the park.

events.name: Holiday Origami at the Library
events.description: Cut and fold festive trees and ornaments with kirigami and modular origami. No supplies needed; beginners welcome.

events.name: Duffy Hudson Presents Christmas Magic
events.description: Duffy the Magic Elf performs holiday magic for kids and adults at the Boulder City Library.

events.name: A Christmas Carol – One Man Show by Duffy Hudson
events.description: Broadway and film actor Duffy Hudson plays all 30 characters of A Christmas Carol without props or costumes.

events.name: Holiday Handicrafts for Kids
events.note: Free library program for kids and caregivers.
events.description: An hour of holiday and winter crafts for young children and their caregivers.

events.name: Noon Year's Eve at Boulder City Library
events.note: Free kids' New Year's countdown at noon.
events.description: New Year's activities for kids with a countdown at noon in the library's Community Room.
